4f646b975ff3.content: RIP Autumn, my beloved friend, companion and cat. I found her in a forest area near the edge of the city about ten years ago. She was orphaned as a kitten. I was taking care of her mother who had disappeared, Autumn and her siblings were left to fend for themselves when they were only half grown. She and her sister Blackball survived and grew to adulthood. They were still feral but I had gained their trust and they would come to me and let me pet them after some time. Autumn was a kind and gentle creature but a warrior born. One night as I was going to feed her, I found her facing off against the largest raccoon I have ever seen. She had kittens of her own at this time and the raccoon had them pinned on a high concrete pedestal. This was no social visit, he meant to kill them. Autumn's ears were pulled back and with tooth and claw she struck at him unfazed at his size and strength, she was prepared to fight to the death to protect her own. Despite her valor however it was a good thing I got there when I did. I drove him away and Autumn rubbed up against my leg when I went to check on her. I decided to bring her home with me and there she has stayed ever since. She was born to sleeping on the grass or rocks of her forest home but I always made sure she had a pillow to sleep on and food to eat without fear of black masked marauders in the night when she came to live with me. I love you Autumn, I will find you when my time comes to cross Bifrost Bridge. Fare well sweet girl.
